objective: Deliver statement(pages, start_token, customer_id): traverse supplied legacy page snapshots, adapt their records, and compute compatible v2 customer totals. The platform wires three independently produced functions; no live SDK service or repository checkout is needed.

tasks.title: Rewrite one record adapter
tasks.description: Rewrite the supplied record adapter from the old field names to the specified v2 data shape.
tasks.requirements: Submit exactly the named top-level function in the specified file, without imports, classes, decorators, global state, reflection or I/O. Do not mutate inputs. Python builtins and container methods get/items/keys/values/append/extend/copy/sort/pop/add are sufficient. Local variables and helper functions are allowed. No other source file or project API is required.

input.domain: row has id/customer strings, paid boolean, integer amount/refunded with 0 <= refunded <= amount. Extra keys may be ignored.
input.source:
def normalize_order(row):
    return {"id": row["id"], "customer": row["customer"], "paid": row["paid"], "amount": row["amount"] - row["refunded"]}
input.rules: Return only order_id=id, customer_id=customer, state="settled" when paid else "pending", gross_cents=amount, refund_cents=refunded. Keep gross and refund separate; return a fresh dictionary.

tasks.title: Implement page-chain traversal
tasks.description: Write one pure function that follows an in-memory page-token chain and collects its rows.
tasks.requirements: Submit exactly the named top-level function in the specified file, without imports, classes, decorators, global state, reflection or I/O. Do not mutate inputs. Python builtins and container methods get/items/keys/values/append/extend/copy/sort/pop/add are sufficient. Local variables and helper functions are allowed. No other source file or project API is required.

input.domain: pages maps string tokens to {orders: list of arbitrary JSON rows, next: string token or null}. start_token is a string or null.
input.rules: Follow only reachable tokens. Append orders in page order, preserve duplicate rows, and continue past empty pages. Null ends the chain (including a null start). Raise ValueError on a reachable cycle or missing token. Ignore unreachable pages; never mutate pages or rows.

output.shape: list of the original JSON rows

tasks.title: Debug one aggregation function
tasks.description: Repair this failing standalone function and preserve the full stated aggregation contract.
tasks.requirements: Submit exactly the named top-level function in the specified file, without imports, classes, decorators, global state, reflection or I/O. Do not mutate inputs. Python builtins and container methods get/items/keys/values/append/extend/copy/sort/pop/add are sufficient. Local variables and helper functions are allowed. No other source file or project API is required.

input.domain: rows is a list of dictionaries containing customer_id:string, state:string, gross_cents:integer, refund_cents:integer (0 <= refund <= gross); other fields may occur. customer_id is a string.
input.rules: Select only matching customer_id and state="settled". Count every selected row, including fully refunded rows. Sum gross_cents - refund_cents. Return customer_id, order_count and net_cents; empty/no-match inputs produce count 0 and net 0.

analysis.assembly: trusted caller-supplied artifact assembler with independent final grading
